name: flow
description: Seth's Claude Code plugins: flow for a working session (frame, triage, write, reflect) and mcp-servers for building MCP servers.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Skills in session order: frame a task (ambition, decide), triage repo work across agent sessions (roundup, epics), deliver an item locally (deliver), write in Seth's style (style), and reflect on past sessions (introspect).

plugins.name: mcp-servers
plugins.description: For building MCP servers: audits a server's source code against a 48-check best-practices rubric and returns a 0-100 score plus a structured, located change list.
